changeLog.change: Restricted GET /users/:userId to admins (verifyAdmin added). Previously any authenticated user could fetch any other user's full document by id with no ownership or admin check — leaked email, admin flag, googleId, hasPassword to any logged-in user. No client code called this route.

Removed unique constraint on places.title. Previously title had a global unique index, which incorrectly prevented different users from creating places with the same title and was the likely root cause of a POST /places 500/duplicate-key bug. A per-owner compound unique index ({owner, title}) was considered but rejected — decided titles don't need to be unique at all, even for the same user. The old single-field unique index (title_1) was dropped via a one-off migration script (server/scripts/drop-title-index.js). No replacement index was created.

Shipped Sharp-based image compression pipeline (server/utils/imageProcessing.js) sitting in front of GCS upload: resize to 1600px max width, EXIF auto-rotate + strip, format-specific quality. GCS Cache-Control set to 1yr on uploaded objects.
